description: withdraw(amount) is `whenNotPaused` but NOT `nonReentrant`. Order: _updatePool() -> _claimRewards(msg.sender) [mint phUSD + safeTransfer rewardToken] -> THEN compute remaining/dust-handle -> update user.amount/debts -> totalStaked -= ... -> phUSD.safeTransfer(msg.sender, actualWithdrawAmount). The `_claimRewards` external calls happen with `user.amount` at its OLD value and BEFORE the debt rebase, so a reentering call into `claim()`/`withdraw()`/`stake()` from a token hook reads stale state and double-claims. The final `phUSD.safeTransfer` happens AFTER state updates, so reentry from THAT call would see consistent post-withdraw state for `msg.sender` but could still re-enter cross-function. Matches REENTRANCY-ERC777 (external calls + later state changes + no guard).
vulnerableConditionsMet: _claimRewards external interactions occur BEFORE user.amount and debt updates
missingMitigations: Rebase debts and decrement totalStaked BEFORE _claimRewards
